lead_text:
Dear Generali Team,
I would like to request a quotation for comprehensive private health insurance for two adults, currently residing in Voula, Greece.
We are interested in your Life On Premium / Medical Prime plan, or the closest comparable comprehensive medical insurance plan available.
Could you please provide details regarding:

* Hospitalisation and inpatient coverage
* Outpatient consultations and specialist visits
* Diagnostic tests and examinations
* Emergency treatment and day surgery
* Direct billing with private hospitals in Greece
* International / overseas medical coverage
* Annual health check-ups and preventive care
* Prescription medication coverage
* Annual premium
* Deductible options
* Coverage limits
* Waiting periods
* Treatment of pre-existing conditions
* Renewal terms and age limits
* Medical underwriting requirements
* Earliest possible policy start date

Please let us know what information or documents you require in order to prepare the quotation.
Kind regards
reply_draft:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry and for considering Generali as your health insurance provider. Generali is a well-known insurer in Greece, distinguished for its hospital cover and the range of benefits it offers.

You sent a detailed list of questions, and I cover each of them in this reply or in the quotation.

To be fully transparent about your requirements: Generali's programmes cover hospitalisation in Greece very well, but doctors, tests and emergency visits are covered mainly within their partner network. Visits to doctors of your own choice outside the network are limited to a set number a year. In more detail, on a recent Generali quotation:

Life On:

* Hospital cover (Hospital Premium Flexi): annual capital of €620,000, €940,000 or €1,240,000 per person (the quote I have is €620,000), 100% in Greece and abroad (95% in the USA and Canada) after your participation, and 100% with no participation in public hospitals. Partner hospitals settle directly with Generali, so you pay only your participation. [CONFIRM: figures are from a recent quote for one adult]
* You choose your room: A (private) or B (semi-private). Room A has a higher premium than the same cover with room B. The quote I have is for room A.
* You choose your participation: €0, €750, €1,500, €3,000, €5,000 or €10,000 a year, and a higher participation lowers the premium. With €750 or €1,500, the seven listed serious-illness categories carry no participation.
* Life On is built from modules, so you can add or drop prevention, doctors and exams, hospital, rehabilitation, life cover and accident covers to suit you.
* Wide network of partner hospitals, including Athens: Athens Eye Hospital, Henry Dunant, Euroclinic Athens, Euroclinic Children, ENT Clinic Karras, Iaso, Iaso Children, Iatriko Athinon, Pediatric Center Athens, Iatriko Peristeriou, Iatriko Psychikou, Iatropolis, Leukos Stavros, Metropolitan Hospital, Metropolitan General, Mitera, Mitera Children, Therapis, Hygeia; Thessaloniki: Agios Lucas, Euromedica General Clinic, Euromedica Kyanous Stavros, Iatriko Diavalkaniko Thessaloniki; Other regions: Creta Interclinic (Crete), Iaso Thessalias (Thessaly), Ophthalmica, Laservision.
* Doctors & Exams Premium: unlimited visits to partner doctors at €20 per visit, a family doctor at €40 for the first visit and €12 after that, and four visits a year to a doctor of your own choice outside the network, reimbursed up to €20 a visit. Diagnostic tests at partner diagnostic centres up to €2,500 a year with no participation, on a referral from a partner doctor.
* Prevention Standard: an annual check-up (19 tests for adults, 11 for children), with other preventive exams at preferential prices.
* Also in the hospital cover: costs 30 days before and 60 days after surgery, day surgery with no participation, a private nurse for up to 30 days, emergency medical transport up to €5,000, a second medical opinion, a daily allowance when you do not claim, and the option of continuing cover for protected members without a new health check.

Waiting periods (Hospital Premium Flexi, Article 5): appendectomy the first three months of the first year; nasal growths and tonsillectomy the first year; bowel and genital conditions (except malignancy) and pregnancy complications the first two years; deviated septum, spinal conditions and removal of moles and papillomas the first three years. Doctors & Exams Premium: spinal and knee conditions after the first year. Optional dental cover applies after two years and aesthetic medicine after three. [CONFIRM against the full wording before sending]

Medical Prime:

* Hospital stays in Greece covered at 100% with no participation, up to €300,000 a year per person, in Generali's partner hospitals: Hygeia and Mitera (Hygeia Group) in Athens and Euromedica in Thessaloniki. The room is B (semi-private) by default, and you can upgrade to room A (private) for a contribution of €100 a night. Partner hospitals settle directly with Generali. [CONFIRM: these figures come from a recent quote for one adult and may differ on your family quote; the quote shows no participation 'with use of a social insurance fund', so check how it applies if you do not use one]
* You choose your participation when the policy starts, and a higher one lowers the premium. [CONFIRM: the participation options for this plan]
* Unlimited scheduled visits to partner doctors, €10 per visit.
* Emergencies: a visit to a partner doctor on duty has no participation; a partner specialist called out in an emergency costs €50.
* Diagnostic tests and medical procedures: up to €1,500 per insurance year, with 15% participation, on referral from a partner doctor.
* Physiotherapy: up to €1,000 per insurance year, with 15% participation.
* Annual preventive check-up (14 tests for adults, 5 for children), €10 each, available from six months after the start. Adults can also add specialised preventive exams once a year, from one year after the start.
* Chronic conditions you declare, known or unknown, can be covered after the waiting period, and children are covered up to age 25 if they study.

Waiting periods: doctors and tests are covered from one month after the start. For hospital cover, conditions you declare and already know about are covered after two years (five years if they relate to a malignancy); conditions that were unknown and undeclared after one or two years, depending on the condition; and congenital conditions (other than cardiac) and listed special conditions after ten years.

Since you are looking for outpatient cover for doctors, specialists and tests and cover and direct billing abroad, we would recommend an international private medical insurance (IPMI) plan, alongside, or instead of, a Generali plan.

Generali Greece forwards English-language enquiries like yours to Ashlar Assurance, an independent insurance broker. We are not employed by Generali, and we, not Generali, are responsible for the advice and service we give you. [CONFIRM: add Ashlar's broker registration number] We work with Generali in the Greek market and we also have direct agreements with many IPMI providers, including VUMI, Bupa, Cigna, Allianz Care, IMG, APRIL International, OneHealth, Now Health and Morgan Price, so we can compare both routes for you. We are paid only by commission from the insurer you choose, and we do not charge you any fee.

IPMI plans can combine:

* Outpatient cover for doctors, specialists, diagnostics and prescriptions, with emergency care including visits where admission is not required
* Cover and direct billing outside Greece, in Europe or worldwide

If these are not a high priority, we can instead provide a Generali hospital cover quotation alongside the IPMI one, so you can compare both and decide what suits you best. Generali requires a valid Greek AFM for each adult.

Prescription medication is not covered under the doctors and tests cover; chronic-condition medication is available only through a separate add-on. Life On: Hospital stays abroad are covered at 100% (95% in the USA and Canada) after your participation on the quotation I have; outpatient care abroad is not part of the programme. [CONFIRM against the wording] Medical Prime: Hospital stays abroad are covered at 100% (90% in the USA and Canada), with prior approval and your social insurance in force; you pay and claim the money back, so there is no direct billing abroad. Outpatient care abroad is not part of the programme. [CONFIRM against the wording]

For the Generali option I will send the exclusions, direct billing and how pre-existing conditions are treated as the policy wording states them. I will confirm the annual premium, the medical underwriting requirements, renewal terms and age limits and the earliest possible start date with Generali.

For the international options we will also provide the participating hospital list, direct-billing arrangements, reimbursement for out-of-network doctors, waiting periods, exclusions, annual limits, deductible options, the annual premium, how pre-existing conditions are treated, the medical underwriting requirements, renewal terms and age limits, the earliest possible start date, prescription cover, check-up and preventive cover and overseas cover.

I will also check the policy wording on: pre-existing conditions.

To prepare your quotation, please send us:
1. Dates of birth and nationalities of everyone to be insured
2. Whether each adult holds a valid Greek AFM (Generali requires one)
3. Any existing conditions or ongoing treatment
4. Hospitals or doctors you would like to keep using
5. Whether you want cover in Greece only, Europe, or worldwide
6. Any extras you want, such as maternity, dental, or check-ups
7. Your approximate annual budget
8. Your preferred start date
